title: Sync Lipsync 3
description: sync-3 most powerful lipsync model yet, featuring native visual intelligence for professional-quality video.

inputs.name: sync_mode
inputs.tooltip: Lipsync mode when audio and video durations are out of sync.

inputs.name: options_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Emotion prompt for generation. This is a Sync.so option primarily used by react-1. '(not set)' leaves it to the model.
inputs.label: emotion

inputs.name: options_occlusion_detection_enabled
inputs.tooltip: Whether to detect occlusion during generation. Sync.so handles this automatically for sync-3, so this option is ignored by sync-3.
inputs.label: occlusion_detection

inputs.name: options_temperature
inputs.tooltip: Controls how expressive lipsync can be; 0 is least expressive, 1 is most expressive. Sync.so handles this natively for sync-3, so this option is ignored by sync-3. -1 leaves it to the model.
inputs.label: temperature

inputs.name: options_active_speaker_detection
inputs.tooltip: Active speaker detection configuration for videos with multiple people. JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: options_model_mode
inputs.tooltip: Edit region for the model. This is a Sync.so option primarily used by react-1. '(not set)' leaves it to the model.
inputs.label: model_mode
